source.topic: ERR_DATA parameters, sequence selectors, minimum message capacities, severity, packed time and posting visibility

implementation.traversal: 0 selects oldest; ordinary nonnegative cursors select the next strictly greater retained ID; end sets cursor to 0 and preserves all other outputs
implementation.latest: MAXINT literal/predefined/named constant selects newest and discards sequence output; ordinary MAXINT storage remains rejected
implementation.outputs: Disjoint ordinary exact-type references, message capacities 40..254, text right truncation and complete-field preflight
implementation.messages: Explicit optional error_string/cause_string; fall back to parameter/empty string without native alarm lookup
implementation.time: Explicit packed time or 0 unknown; source posting samples only a supplied calendar; queries and runtime-failure notifications do not acquire a clock
implementation.persistence: Optional presentation metadata preserves old history records; checked monotonic IDs 1..2147483646; reject overflow before append
implementation.handlers: Read all retained scopes including suppressed rows without consuming handler notifications
